# Ghost Continuum
> Open-source Living Digital Immune System - v3.3.7 Crystal Nexus. Tabbed Command Nexus, hover-expand fabric map, native Ghost LAN tab, simple help tips, NSGA-II genomes, multi-plane polymorphic deception, Home Shield, Merkle forensics. Defensive only. Local-first. Zero core npm deps.

Site: https://ghost.jonbailey.xyz/
Hub preview: https://ghost.jonbailey.xyz/hub/
Source: https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/ghost-continuum
License: MIT

## What it is

Ghost Continuum is an open-source polymorphic honeypot and defensive deception engine: traps evolve via NSGA-II, personas morph at runtime, and evidence is Merkle-sealed - for authorized targets on your own network only. Version 3.3.7 Crystal Nexus is a polished tabbed Command Nexus with hover-expand map, Ghost LAN inside the hub, and plain-language help tips.

## Quick answers

- **Offensive?** No. Defensive only.
- **Cloud required?** No. Local-first. Optional Cloudflare edge for sites you already host.
- **Core dependencies?** Zero npm packages in the engine. Node.js 18+.
- **Latest version?** 3.3.7 Crystal Nexus - https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/ghost-continuum/releases/latest
- **Install:** git clone, npm run setup, npm start -> http://127.0.0.1:30000
- **Home Shield:** wizard + kid mode + quiet hours for home / lab operators
- **Command Nexus:** Overview / Ghost LAN / Genome / Forensics / Home Shield tabs; hover map to expand; deck tiles expand upward

- Public site: architecture planes, lifecycle demo, efficacy gauges, quickstart, FAQ
- Command Nexus: Crystal Nexus cockpit at local :30000
